Name: Alcina Dimitrescu in Stardew valley
Author: SiameseBeauty
Description:
You will need Stardew valley Expanded in order to have Olivia. Then,to see sprites and portraits to put these in, enter: Stardew Valley -> Mods -> Stardew Valley Expanded -> [CP] Stardew Valley Expanded -> assets -> CharacterFiles.
You will see folders OverworldSprites and Portraits. Find "Olivia" folders in there, and replace her portraits and sprites with Lady Dimitrescu's.
(OverworldSprites is where you put sprites, Portraits - Portraits )
Take out Alcina's portraits and sprites out of these downloaded folders and replace Olivia's in those folders. If it asks to replace the file since it already exists, say yes.
You can do a backup of Olivia's if you decide to ever return her, then you won't need to replace anything. Simply put these files in the folders.
